title: Shared pipeline config
description: Configuration for the govuk-once/platform-shared-ci-cd PR, cleanup and release pipelines. Commit as .github/pipeline.yml.
markdownDescription:
Configuration for the `govuk-once/platform-shared-ci-cd` PR, cleanup and release pipelines. Commit as `.github/pipeline.yml`.

[Config reference](https://github.com/govuk-once/platform-shared-ci-cd/blob/main/docs/pipelines.md#config-reference)

application.description: Human-readable service name used in notifications, e.g. UDP.

codeartifact.description: Configure CodeArtifact auth before every pnpm install, assuming the environment's DEPLOYMENT_ROLE via OIDC.
codeartifact.markdownDescription:
Configure CodeArtifact auth (writes `.npmrc`) before every `pnpm install`.

Assumes the `DEPLOYMENT_ROLE` secret of the job's GitHub environment via OIDC, so that role must be allowed to read from CodeArtifact.

aws.description: AWS settings shared by every job.

title.description: PR title check. Set to false to disable.

pattern.description: Extended regular expression the title must match.

examples.description: Example titles, one per line, shown on failure.

guidance-url.description: Link to title guidance, shown on failure.

skip-actors.description: Comma-separated actors whose PRs skip the title check.

comment.description: Maintain a guidance comment on the PR.

ephemeral.description: Per-PR environment, deployed on every PR push and destroyed when the PR closes. name defaults to 'ephemeral'.
ephemeral.markdownDescription:
Per-PR environment, deployed on every PR push and destroyed by `pr-cleanup.yml` when the PR closes.

`name` defaults to `ephemeral`. Use `{pr}` in `env` to keep stacks per PR, e.g. `DEVELOPER_ID: "pr-{pr}"`.

quality.description: Quality checks run on PRs and before each release.

environment.description: GitHub environment whose DEPLOYMENT_ROLE quality jobs assume. Defaults to the ephemeral environment when AWS credentials are needed.

aws.description: Configure AWS credentials in the checks job, e.g. for cdk synth.

setup.description: Command run once before checks, e.g. installing Python tooling.
examples: python3 -m pip install semgrep pre-commit checkov

checks.description: Commands run in order in the checks job.

dependency-review.description: Fail PRs that add dependencies with high-severity vulnerabilities.

conventional-commits.description: Require at least one Conventional Commit in the PR.

sonar.markdownDescription:
SonarQube scan with quality-gate wait. Needs the `SONAR_TOKEN` and `SONAR_URL` secrets.

`true`, or `{test, args}` to produce coverage first.

test.description: Command run before the scan to produce coverage.

enabled.description: Run semantic-release before promoting. When false, the short commit SHA is the version.

environments.description: Environments promoted in order on each push to main (at most four).

topic-arn-ssm-parameter.description: SSM parameter holding the AWS Chatbot SNS topic ARN. Use instead of topic-arn.

notify-on.description: Defaults to [failure] when a topic is set.
notify-on.markdownDescription:
Defaults to `[failure]` when a topic is set.

- `success`: posts after each environment deploys.
- `failure`: posts once if the release pipeline fails, naming the stage.

hooks.title: Hook list
hooks.description: Commands run in order. Each item is a command string or {name, run}.

name.description: Step name shown in the job log.

run.description: Command, run with bash -euo pipefail from the repository root.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: One deployment stage, run as a single job in its GitHub environment.

name.description: Shown in job names and exported as PIPELINE_ENV. Required for environments[].

environment.description: GitHub environment holding DEPLOYMENT_ROLE. Defaults to name.
environment.markdownDescription: GitHub environment the job runs in. Its `DEPLOYMENT_ROLE` secret and protection rules apply. Defaults to `name`.

env.description: Environment variables for all commands. Placeholders: {pr}, {sha}, {env}, {version}.
env.markdownDescription:
`NAME: value` exported to every command.

Placeholders: `{pr}` PR number, `{sha}` commit SHA, `{env}` stage name, `{version}` version deployed.

working-directory.description: Where deploy/destroy run and the version is stamped. Hooks always run from the repository root.

destroy.description: Destroy command (pr.ephemeral only), run by pr-cleanup.yml.

post-deploy.description: Run after deploy, e.g. e2e tests. A failure stops promotion.
post-deploy.markdownDescription:
Run after deploy, e.g. e2e tests. A failure stops promotion.

Hooks see `STACK_OUTPUTS` when `outputs-stack` is set.

outputs-stack.description: CloudFormation stack whose outputs are exported as STACK_OUTPUTS.
outputs-stack.markdownDescription: CloudFormation stack whose outputs are exported to post-deploy hooks as `STACK_OUTPUTS` JSON, e.g. `jq -r .ApiUrl <<< "$STACK_OUTPUTS"`.

release-notification.description: Send the Slack release notification for major/minor releases after this stage.

slack-channel.description: Slack channel for the release notification.
